layout.label: Generate Residuals vs Fitted Diagnostic Plot

r_template:
local({
  fmla <- as.formula(paste('{{escapeR dep_var}} ~', paste(c({{#each indep_vars}}'{{escapeR this}}',{{/each}} NULL), collapse = ' + ')))
  fit <- lm(fmla, data = .active_data)
  rrad_emit_table(broom::tidy(fit), title = 'Linear Regression Coefficients')
  rrad_emit_table(broom::glance(fit), title = 'Model Summary (R² and F-Statistic)')
  if ({{chk_diagnostics}}) {
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(Fitted = fitted(fit), Residuals = resid(fit)), ggplot2::aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(color = '#4f46e5', alpha = 0.8) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = '#ef4444') +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::labs(title = 'Residuals vs Fitted Values', x = 'Fitted Values', y = 'Residuals')
    rrad_emit_plot(p, title = 'Linear Regression Diagnostic Plot')
  }
})
